B01/B02 are education rows selected by a diagnostic substring heuristic and are not frozen NEWGRAD positives; B03/B04 are responsibility wording rows, so these are not verified entry-plus-responsibility co-occurrences.
coverage_judgment.reason: Only four direct D67 rows per question are available, selected by directed retrieval rather than an accuracy design. They expose failure modes but cannot validate aggregate semantic accuracy or prevalence.
coverage_judgment.usable_for: One bounded root judgment on whether the reported D67 findings must remain candidate wording and which examples explain the boundary.

evidence_versions.D64_wave1_membership: 4/4 source shards are complete, QA-pass members of D67 frozen69

frozen_rule_corrections.general_work: Requires explicit total/overall/general/professional/work/working/employment experience, no specific tool/domain/task match, and a restricted tail; it is not a no-object fallback.
frozen_rule_corrections.graduate_language: Matches new/recent/fresh graduates or graduates welcome/encouraged to apply; ordinary graduate program or graduate-of-school education language is outside this flag.
frozen_rule_corrections.needs_review: Raw scope and strength strings remain evidence attributes; needs_review clauses are not promoted to clear unconditional/required outcomes.
frozen_rule_corrections.responsibility: Current-duty responsibility wording does not establish job seniority or authority.

root_static_corrections: A02 has objects=[] and outcome_status=needs_review; it is not a positive general_work flag. Frozen general_work requires an explicit GENERAL cue, no recognized specific object, and an allowed bounded tail.

A04 retains occupation_task wording but its numeric bound is null because multiple experience/duration clauses require review. Its raw scope string does not establish a substantively unconditional minimum.

B01/B02 are degree_phrase education evidence retrieved by the diagnostic packet heuristic. Frozen NEWGRAD matches only new/recent/fresh graduates or graduates welcome/encouraged to apply, so these rows do not demonstrate graduate_language false positives.
B03 is team-lead wording in a current-skill/duty context and B04 is independent-decision wording under Specific Job Requirements. They support responsibility wording candidates, not seniority.
stop_rule: Use this packet once; record the decision without new sampling, parser changes, or full-corpus work.
